findings.name: Broken Object Level Authorization
findings.detail: Object-level authorization appears to be enforced.

findings.name: Missing Rate Limiting
findings.detail: Sent 30 requests in 0.1s with no rate limiting response (no 429 status code returned).
findings.remediation: Implement rate limiting (e.g. 5 requests/minute per IP). Return 429 Too Many Requests. Consider account lockout after 5 failed attempts.
